failure_mode: The system does not keep content that a source delivered, and reports nothing.
cause: A source adds content that the definition does not describe. The system converts what it recognises and discards the rest.
effect: Data exists at the source and never reaches life state. A stop is reported, but this is not reported.
detection: The system compares each delivery with the form that its definition states.

failure_mode: The system gives State Custody a value in a form that the source did not use.
cause: The source changes a unit or a time reference, and the definition still states the old one.
effect: Life state holds a wrong value, and the value carries the mark of an observation, which is the strongest mark that the platform gives.
detection: The system compares the form of each value with the form that its definition states.

failure_mode: The system gives the time at which it received a value as the time of the observation.
cause: The source supplies no time of observation, and the system puts a time in its place.
effect: Currency is decided on a timeline that no source supports. A reader cannot see that the time is not true.
detection: An item that carries a time of observation that its source did not supply.

failure_mode: The system gives State Custody content that the definition of the source does not describe.
cause: The source returns a wider record than the definition names, and the system passes all of it.
effect: The platform holds data that the user did not give it, and the widening did not pass the gate that DEC-013 states.
detection: The system compares each delivery with the content that its definition states.

failure_mode: Two items from different sources carry the same identifier.
cause: The identifier comes from the source and the system does not make it unique across sources.
effect: State Custody treats one item as a later value of the other. One item is lost, and nothing reports the loss.
detection: The system tests each identifier for uniqueness when it hands the item over.

failure_mode: The identifier of an item is not the same across deliveries from one source.
cause: The identifier comes from a field that the source rewrites.
effect: The same item arrives as a new item. Life state holds it two times, and an agent counts it two times.
detection: The system compares an item that arrives with the items that State Custody holds.

failure_mode: The system accepts an incomplete delivery as a complete delivery.
cause: The source returns part of the data that it promised, and the delivery reports success.
effect: Life state shows that nothing exists where data exists. An agent answers that there is nothing.
detection: The system compares each delivery with what its definition states.

failure_mode: The system reports a source that did not fail.
cause: The definition does not state whether the source delivers full state or differences, so a source with nothing to report looks like a source that stopped.
effect: The reports stop being trusted, and a source that did fail is not seen. REQ-PL-004 holds in the model and not in use.
detection: A person compares a report with the state of the source.

failure_mode: Acquisition does not complete inside the interval that the definition states.
cause: The volume is more than the host can process, or a backlog follows an outage.
effect: Life state lags its source without a limit, and the interval in the definition means nothing.
detection: The system reports the time of the most recent delivery for each source.

failure_mode: The system continues to acquire from a source after its definition is withdrawn.
cause: Withdrawal stops the definition and does not stop the acquisition that uses it.
effect: The platform continues to take data that the user withdrew. The effect is the effect of RSK-PL-005 and the user cannot reverse it.
detection: The system compares each acquisition with the definitions that are in force.

failure_mode: The system does not acquire a difference that a source reported.
cause: The source delivers differences. The system stops, or loses its position in the sequence, and continues from the wrong place.
effect: One item in life state stays wrong for as long as the source does not report it again. Nothing reports the loss, because each later delivery succeeds.
detection: The system compares the full state of the source with life state, at the interval that the definition states.
